messages:
Jamal: tossing an idea out — a compact 'audit snapshot' pane in Console: one-line rows for recent changes, badges for sensitive/diff/exportable, click to preview or queue full export. low-latency and privacy-first. thoughts?
Maria: yes. Requirements: sub-50ms list queries, small precomputed summary, flags for UI, link to export pipeline. keep row footprint tiny.
Olivia: privacy flags first: tenants can choose pseudonymization mode (none/hashed/pseudonymized). default hashed for SSO enterprise. we must not leak emails in the minibuffer.
Derek: API proposal: return both actor_display and actor_id separately, plus precomputed_summary and flags (has_diff, sensitive, has_justification). UI schema example: 
```
{"ts":"2026-08-11T14:02:10Z","actor_id":"acct_9x","actor_display":"Jamal Q.","actor_role":"platform-admin","action":"update","target":"routing.policy/tenant-42","summary":"priority 2->4","flags":["has_diff"]}
```
Jamal: add small artifact bits: diff_token (opaque) and sensitive_mask boolean so UI shows a lock icon and refuses inline preview when true. Also include optional rollout_id if part of rollout.
Maria: UX: badges + tooltip with short_summary and a link to Preview. Preview should call a lightweight endpoint that returns N NDJSON lines + estimated_total_size + total_count. avoids heavy queries for full export.
Olivia: retention note: snapshot rows cached 30 days for speed. full exports adhere to tenant retention and export quotas; large exports are staged to object storage and we return signed URLs. legal might require raw actor ids for enterprise exports — make that configurable in tenant export settings.
Derek: quotas: propose soft threshold 100MB/day per tenant, hard 1GB/day. export_preview should be free; full export beyond soft limit returns 429 suggesting sampling params, beyond hard returns 413 with appeal link. API returns estimated_size bytes and a sampling_recommendation field.
Jamal: telemetry we should emit: snapshot_open, row_expand, preview_request(estimate), export_request(estimate), export_ready, export_failed. include tenant_id, actor_role, rollout_id. sample: snapshot_open{tenant, user_role, sample_window}.
Maria: small product ask: capture optional justification text on change and surface it in preview/export. show a condensed "why" on hover in the snapshot.
Derek: implementation: server-side job to precompute summary strings and flags at write-time so snapshot queries are cheap. add an export_preview endpoint that streams first N lines and returns total_count + estimated_size.
engops-bot: export job queued job_id=exp_20260811_77 tenant=tenant-42 est_size=12MB preview_lines=100
Jamal: next steps: ship snapshot + preview behind FF, canary 10% tenants. Olivia to spec pseudonymization knobs and privacy matrix, Derek to spec export_preview API and quota responses, Maria to produce UI mock with badges+tooltips. pairing 4pm today to iterate. :thumbsup:
